Original gamebook successfully retrieved; p.13 explicitly annotates Taylor-Britt Q4 15:00 and Aaron Jones Q4 12:22 injuries, and records Taylor-Britt out after the 8:32 play. Also official final, lineups, QBs, specialists, and p.16 snaps.
Dated Week 7 depth chart: Ward/Taylor-Britt on one corner row, Gardner on opposite corner row, Walley/Gushiken at nickel.
Colts confirm inactives and Saturday elevations of cornerback Kenneth Harris and linebacker Germaine Pratt.
Indianapolis rule-outs Warren, Gould, Gardner and original role of injury for Boettcher/Walley.
Full team Week 7 injury list; no injury designation for inactive Dalton Tucker or active DNP DJ Giddens.
Official postgame report confirms Gardner calf absence and game-day Walley and Taylor-Britt injury exits.

Paul Bretl, Colts Wire, reports Week 7 Walley outside opposite Ward in Gardner vacancy, Taylor-Britt mostly nickel, then Harris outside and Gushiken slot after both injured; corroborated by original gamebook participation and team postgame injury confirmation.
Official EA Madden NFL 27 Week 7 Ratings, Indianapolis CB Kenneth Harris, exact EA ID 4841, OVR 66; exact name/team/position/height/weight match official Colts.
Club identifies Week 7 elevated Kenneth Harris and corresponding roster move with injured Taylor-Britt.
Club enumerates final six inactives and Max Brosmer emergency-QB status.
Vikings say all players on active roster available, Mason activated and DeeJay Dallas elevated.
Vikings report pre-existing 1A/1B Mason/Jones role, Jones left with a knee injury at the end of his Q4 17-yard gain.

Contemporaneous reporting directly identifies Walley as his outside relief opposite Ward and Taylor-Britt as mostly nickel. After Walley exits, Harris takes outside; EA lists Harris exact 66 OVR, in the same calibrated zero band as Walley, so the numerical outside-role replacement value is invariant across the change. Reserve Harris to this continuation only; no secondary full-game adjustment or second role credit.
